base: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity complete landscape game battle interface design concept for Grid Defenders. Reference image is a 16-screen contact sheet: use ONLY screen 1 at TOP LEFT as layout reference, do NOT recreate contact sheet or other 15 screens. Output single full landscape screen approximately 20:9, edge to edge, at least 1600x720 visual detail. Same layout for comparison: compact wave/time/resources top-left, small pause/speed/settings top-right, large top-down rectangular grassy battlefield occupying main center, visibly subtle 5-column x4-row deployment grid on left half with tiny allied soldiers, 6 small red/yellow/blue slimes on right half, 6 compact menu buttons aligned along bottom center. Keep reference's broad layout. Restyle ENTIRE interface, every button, icons, terrain together. No modal, no shops or inventory open, no phone device frame, no extra sidebars, no character portraits enlarged, no perspective tilt. UI text short and legible: "WAVE 01", "00:18", "120", "3", bottom "UNITS", "HERO", "SHOP", "BAG", "FORM", "START". Preserve battlefield legibility, do not obscure units with ornament or VFX. This is art direction concept, not implementation screenshot. Add small discreet upper-center concept number/title.
